_purpose: Affective OBSERVABLES catalog for M19 -- measured phenomena (NOT interpretations) that the affect literature reports, which the SAME single substrate that reproduced the M12 cognitive observables must ALSO reproduce, WITHOUT per-domain tuning. Kept SEPARATE from brainwave_phenomenology_atlas.json so M12 stays byte-identical; M19 reports its own concordance AND a combined_with_M12 number (the chain pattern used by M13/M14/M15). Reproducing a phenomenon is NOT a claim about whether it is consciously felt (the single hard problem stays OPEN).
_grade_note: Each observable is a CITED behavioural/physiological phenomenon. 'status: matched' = M19 reproduces it on the shared substrate; 'status: target' = catalogued but not yet reproduced (honest owed). The substrate parameters are NEVER chosen to hit these; they come from M0-M18 (measured gamma, measured neuromodulator/HPA/cardiac anchors).

valence_arousal_2d_structure.phenomenon: Affect has a 2D circumplex structure: orthogonal AROUSAL and VALENCE axes.
valence_arousal_2d_structure.ref: Russell 1980 (J Pers Soc Psychol 39:1161); Posner, Russell & Peterson 2005 (Dev Psychopathol 17:715).
valence_arousal_2d_structure.emergence_route: M17 global state carries two near-orthogonal axes: arousal = NE-gain axis; valence = (dopamine-approach minus cortisol-avoid) axis. The orthogonality is MEASURED (their correlation across the swept state space), not imposed.

yerkes_dodson_inverted_u.phenomenon: Cognitive performance is an INVERTED-U function of arousal: too little or too much arousal degrades it.
yerkes_dodson_inverted_u.ref: Yerkes & Dodson 1908 (J Comp Neurol Psychol 18:459); Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 adaptive-gain.
yerkes_dodson_inverted_u.emergence_route: Raising the NE arousal-gain on the R19 substrate first raises then collapses ignitability/SNR -- the inverted-U is an EMERGENT property of the cubic fold (over-gain saturates the well), not a fitted curve. Demonstrates one gain moving a COGNITIVE readout.

arousal_cognition_affect_covariation.phenomenon: A single neuromodulatory state change moves cognition AND affect TOGETHER (the integration prediction).
arousal_cognition_affect_covariation.ref: Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 (LC-NE sets both performance and arousal); Pessoa 2008 (cognition-emotion integration, Nat Rev Neurosci 9:148).
arousal_cognition_affect_covariation.emergence_route: M17: ONE arousal-gain step co-varies a cognitive observable (WM-slot ignitability) and an affective observable (arousal readout). The CORE single-substrate test.

reward_prediction_error_dopamine.phenomenon: Phasic dopamine encodes reward prediction error.
reward_prediction_error_dopamine.emergence_route: ALREADY emerged as M5 (emerge_learned_field); M19 reuses it as the affective valence/learning signal -- same substrate, no new mechanism.

acute_cortisol_peak_minutes.phenomenon: The acute cortisol stress response peaks ~15-40 min after stressor onset, then recovers over ~60-90 min.
acute_cortisol_peak_minutes.emergence_route: M18 HPA cascade (CRH->ACTH->cortisol with CITED kinetics) produces a peak in the cited window. This is the same slow-stress timescale the M12 catalog owed as 'panic_peak_minutes' (autonomic slow peak) -- M19's combined concordance CLOSES that owed observable BY EMERGENCE.

hep_arousal_coupling.phenomenon: Heartbeat-evoked-potential amplitude scales with emotional arousal / interoceptive attention.
hep_arousal_coupling.emergence_route: M18: the cardiac afferent volley (HEP-timed) entering the substrate has an amplitude that tracks the M17 arousal-gain. The 'felt heart' co-varies with affect -- the route the author cited.

mood_congruent_memory.phenomenon: Emotional state biases memory RETRIEVAL toward affect-congruent material.
mood_congruent_memory.emergence_route: M19: the M17 global affective state biases M2 hippocampal pattern-completion -- engrams written under a congruent affect complete more readily when the global state matches. This simultaneously (a) EXERCISES and VERIFIES the M2 retrieval logic end-to-end, and (b) shows ONE substrate carries memory AND emotion.

stress_narrows_attention.phenomenon: Acute arousal/stress narrows the breadth of attention / working memory (cue-utilisation narrowing).
stress_narrows_attention.emergence_route: M17/M19: raising arousal-gain past the Yerkes-Dodson peak reduces the effective number of simultaneously ignitable WM slots -- a COGNITIVE consequence of an AFFECTIVE state, on one substrate.

fear_avoidance_decision_bias.phenomenon: A threat/high-stress state biases action selection toward avoidance.
fear_avoidance_decision_bias.ref: LeDoux 2000 (Annu Rev Neurosci 23:155) defensive circuits; Bishop 2007 anxiety & attention.
fear_avoidance_decision_bias.emergence_route: M20: raising the cortisol/stress-gain shifts the M4 basal-ganglia selection threshold toward the avoidance option -- a TESTABLE functional-access marker for affect.

affective_access_report_change.phenomenon: Does the affective state demonstrably change report/behaviour/attention/decision in the strict access sense (the affective analog of PCI)?
affective_access_report_change.ref: Casali et al. 2013 PCI (Sci Transl Med 5:198ra105); LeDoux & Brown 2017 higher-order theory of emotion (PNAS 114:E2016).
affective_access_report_change.emergence_route: M20 reports this HONEST-NEGATIVE for now (the decision-bias above is necessary but not a full strict-access demonstration). Mirrors the cognitive PCI honest negative. The FELT quality (layer 3) stays OPEN regardless.
